desc: Reduce game to bipartite components; terminal positions are single complete bipartite graphs with S(N-S) edges, so total moves = S(N-S) - M.
Derive N-odd rule (Aoki iff M odd) and even-N closed form (k, c, S, I, M).
Implement O(N+M) iterative BFS/DFS 2-coloring closed form; submission now reads stdin and prints only Aoki/Takahashi (harness removed).
Pass all 3 public samples (N=4 path→Aoki, N=4 two disjoint edges→Takahashi, N=9→Aoki).
Exhaustive bipartite-state minimax DP for N≤6 (state counts 1,2,7,41,376,5177) plus targeted N=8 branch checks matched the formula with no violations.
